Microsoft CEO Apologizes for Service Outage, Cites Technical Glitch

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has apologized for a recent service outage, stating that the disruption was caused by a technical glitch and not hacking. Nadella emphasized the current importance of cyber defenses and infrastructure upgrades in light of global threats. He also discussed AI's potential impact on global infrastructure.
